name: Grand Mercure Bangkok Asoke Residence
short_description: A pet-friendly 5-star residence-style Grand Mercure on a tree-lined Sukhumvit street, 3 minutes' walk from BTS Asoke and MRT Sukhumvit, with a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (367 reviews).
ai_summary: Grand Mercure Bangkok Asoke Residence sits on a tranquil, tree-lined street in the trendy downtown Sukhumvit area, 3 minutes' walk from both BTS Asoke and MRT Sukhumvit stations, with Terminal 21 shopping centre around the corner. The property holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 367 reviews and notably allows pets. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 50/5 Sukhumvit Soi 19, Wattana District, 10110 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
